name: two-leg desk walker (85mm)
_note: Body TRUTH the soul carries = PHONE truth only (what the phone needs to drive the body). Physical pin->servo mapping is CHIP FIRMWARE truth (relay_chip.py), NOT here. The phone sends intent over the shared relay wire as l,r (left,right leg degrees); the chip maps l/r to its own pins. If the live walk moonwalks/spins, that is a firmware servo-swap or sign flip — flag for a bench test, do NOT change this file. SIGNED OFF 2026-06-18.
_servos_note: Two abstract channels. servo_1 = RIGHT leg (wire field r), servo_2 = LEFT leg (wire field l). No Pico pins here on purpose.

walk._cal_note: Physical per-device calibration, overridden by localStorage gb_walk_cal. Policy adapters use execution-local signs/gain and preserve device trims. The legacy policy field remains for older runners; directions below describe current agent routing.

screen_forward.when: stock body, SWAP off, valid trims, forwardwalk not 0; runtime capability is authoritative

screen_backward.command: dir=back routes the unchanged legacy fwd policy

directions.frame: physical screen/body, independent of selected camera
directions.evidence: seven five-second runs on one stock kit; no distance or all-kit guarantee

geometry.note: flat paddle legs screwed to the horns; the servo sweep IS the motion, nothing hangs; 90 = upright

_gestures_note: DEFAULT expressive pack (data). The brain still authors free gestures via body.steps {l,r,ms}; a soul may carry/override its own. The chip only PLAYS keyframes, never decides which exist.
_limits_note: 0808 (Brit): the duty budget is OPT-IN now. Set duty_ms/duty_window_ms here only if a body needs torque rationing; absent, walks honor requested duration with stop, sensor, connection and tip/grab guards plus the chip dead-man.

normal.when: stock legs, SWAP off, valid trims and full gyro/gravity; normalspin=0 restores stock; runtime selection is authoritative

escape.when: explicitly requested after observed lack of turning; no automatic stall detector

spin.evidence: R3 bench-tested on one stock kit across wood and carpets; CCW is slower and can travel on wood; no fixed-angle or all-kit guarantee
